news.headline: U.S. joins Japan in rare coordinated yen-buying intervention
news.body: Japan and the United States conducted a coordinated yen-buying intervention on Aug. 3-4, 2026, Tokyo said, aiming to halt a sharp fall in the currency. Markets reacted with a firmer yen and moves in government bond yields as investors reassessed exchange-rate risks.

footerNote: All times converted from official kickoffs
